Ram Mandir Donation Theft Case: Lawyers Refuse to Represent Accused

An alleged theft and embezzlement case involving donations at the Ram Mandir in Ayodhya has led to a significant development as the Ayodhya Bar Association announced that its members will not represent any of the eight accused. The association has also raised questions about Champat Rai, a figure associated with the temple trust. Meanwhile, the accused have been sent to judicial custody.
